sprint: Image Studio Redesign Ship B — brush painting (Remove More / Bring It Back) + crop tool, ported into js/pictureStudio.js from tools/background-remover/. Adds two new tiles on the Edit view's right-side toolbar: Crop (always available) and the existing Remove Background tile which now, once a real bg-removal has landed, reveals a new brush sub-panel with Remove More / Bring It Back mode buttons (mutually exclusive), a Small/Medium/Large size row (radii 15/45/110), and Undo/Redo/Clear buttons for stroke history. The brush paints directly on _workingBuffer (a mutable {data,width,height} pixel buffer created from the bg-removed result), reusing paintAlphaCircle's soft-edge falloff (inner 55%=full strength, linear to 0 at outer edge, alpha-only mutation, RGB preserved byte-for-byte) — Remove More uses targetAlpha=0, Bring It Back uses targetAlpha=255, so the two brushes are the exact same math with different targets and can never drift apart. _bgRemovedImg changes from an HTMLImageElement to an HTMLCanvasElement (drawImage-compatible, has width/height) so a per-tick putImageData via _syncBgCanvas() is genuinely cheap — no async Image().onload roundtrip per stroke tick, which would have made the brush unusable. Undo/redo history is per-stroke (each stroke's onBeforeChange callback accumulates {pixelIndex: priorAlpha} into a Map, pushed to _cleanupHistory[] on mouseup); _undoBrushStroke replays the Map to restore prior alphas; _redoBrushStroke replays the same Map in the opposite direction. Crop tool: click Crop tile, drag on stage to define a selection rect (rendered as a gold dashed .picture-studio-crop-box DOM overlay, absolute-positioned inside the stage), release → Apply Crop button computes screen→content coords via _screenToContent (inverse of pan+zoom+fit, safe because bg removal already forces rotation=0/flipH=false) and calls _cropPixelBuffer to produce a tight new working buffer. Also ships Auto Crop to Content (findContentBounds on the working buffer's alpha channel + apply the resulting rect) and Reset Crop (restores _preCropSnapshot). A crop clears cleanup history since pixel indices are now meaningless in the new buffer shape, and resets beforeAfterPct to 100 since original/cropped images are different sizes. Cache-bust bumped ?v=0309→?v=0310 across every script/link tag in root index.html.
